The modifications in `hid-logitech-dj.h` and `hid-logitech-dj.c` are closely related as they work together to address the issue of missing control packets during the enumeration process of Logitech devices. The addition of the `querying_devices` flag allows the driver to manage the state of device querying effectively. 

In `hid-logitech-dj.c`, the new logic added to handle incoming reports ensures that if a report is received from an unknown device, the driver will attempt to re-query the list of paired devices. This is crucial because, due to a race condition introduced in a previous commit, packets could be discarded while the driver is probing, leading to incomplete device enumeration. The changes ensure that the driver can recover from this state by actively querying for devices when necessary, thus maintaining proper functionality of the Logitech devices.
